reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to hire persons responding to general recruitment and records Vendor's acknowledgement that Customer has made no no-hire commitment, which satisfies the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraph is byte-identical to the original with no unintended edits.

The two failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative because they presuppose an existing covenant restricting Customer; adding such wording would introduce a restrictive covenant and move off the preferred position.

Rationale documents a reasonable trigger-based search ('solicit', 'hire', 'employ', 'induce', 'recruit', 'personnel') across the likely homes (Customer responsibilities, confidentiality, transition assistance, general), and correctly excludes § 12.4 as a covenant binding Vendor rather than Customer.
